name: talk-meeting-signal-credentials
description: Exclude credential-bearing WebSocket request URLs before accepting Talk meeting connections. Review all other sinks and external log exporters too.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="talk-auth" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND httpRequest.requestUrl =~ "/api/auth/meeting-signal/rtc"
